name: ToBidMediationXHAdapter-RC
summary: ToBid RC Mediation Adapter for XingheAd.
description:
ToBid RC mediation adapter for XingheAd, covering init,
splash, interstitial, rewarded video, and native
(express/self-render). This pod uses the same binary
framework as ToBidMediationXHAdapter and depends on
ToBid-iOS-RC for media that require the RC ToBid SDK.
